blocking_reasons: No target-1251 three-line-specific preregistered empirical model and validation runner exists.
E019_THREE_TICKET_PORTFOLIO_COVERAGE_v1 is explicitly POST_HOC_EXPLORATORY and underperformed its same-target random bundle baseline; it is not a strict-pass candidate.
E043 H1250-A and E044 H1250-B V2 are preregistered five-line studies for target 1250 and are ineligible as three-line evidence for target 1251.
The existing five-line strict finalizer is intentionally blocked for target 1251; no three-line finalizer/readiness artifact exists.
The policy requires prospective confirmation but does not specify the minimum prospective target count or completion rule.

ineligible_research.E019: POST_HOC_EXPLORATORY; 645 targets; fixed bundle mean max hits 1.4186 vs random 1.4531; any2 0.4310 vs 0.4410; any3 0.0558 vs 0.0710; winning-union coverage 2.0651 vs 2.1025.

note: This is an explicit readiness audit only, not a model evaluation, not a strict PASS/FAIL test, and not a purchase recommendation. No thresholds or policy gates were changed.
